title: Odoo Implementation
tagline: Learn requirement gathering, process mapping, solution design, configuration planning, testing, go-live, and handover.
description: An Odoo implementor must understand people, processes, priorities, and system behavior. The role is not limited to configuring applications — it requires discovering what the business truly needs and guiding the organization through change.
This course follows the implementation lifecycle from first discovery meeting to a tested solution, trained users, go-live plan, and handover package.
learningOutcomes: Gather and document clear business requirements
Map current and future business processes
Design an Odoo solution aligned with operational priorities
Plan configuration, testing, and user acceptance
Support training, go-live, handover, and early adoption
whoItsFor: System admins progressing from platform management into implementation delivery
Business analysts turning business pain points into clear requirements and solution maps
Functional consultants structuring configuration, testing, and client-facing delivery
Project and operations leads connecting operational knowledge with ERP project execution
requirements: Confident Odoo usage across multiple applications
System administration or ERP support experience is helpful

curriculum.title: Implementation Role and Project Mindset
curriculum.description: Understand responsibilities, stakeholders, scope, communication, and implementation success factors.

curriculum.title: Business Discovery and Requirements
curriculum.description: Ask effective questions, document processes, identify pain points, and clarify priorities.

curriculum.title: Process Mapping and Solution Design
curriculum.description: Translate current and future workflows into Odoo modules, roles, decisions, and data structures.

curriculum.title: Configuration Planning
curriculum.description: Plan companies, applications, settings, approvals, master data, and cross-department dependencies.

curriculum.title: Testing and User Acceptance
curriculum.description: Design scenarios, validate results, document issues, and manage user acceptance.

curriculum.title: Training, Go-Live, and Handover
curriculum.description: Prepare users, launch operations, manage early support, and transfer knowledge responsibly.

curriculum.title: Capstone Implementation Scenario
curriculum.description: Analyze a realistic company, define requirements, design the solution, and present an implementation roadmap.

projects.title: Discovery Workshop
projects.description: Plan and conduct a structured requirements session for a multi-department company.

projects.title: Solution Blueprint
projects.description: Map processes, modules, roles, data, integrations, risks, and acceptance criteria.

projects.title: Go-Live Readiness Plan
projects.description: Prepare testing, training, migration, support, and handover activities.

faq.question: Is this a technical development course?
faq.answer: No. It is primarily a functional implementation track focused on business analysis, solution design, configuration planning, testing, and delivery.

faq.question: Do I need client experience?
faq.answer: No, but prior operations, support, administration, or business-analysis experience will help.

faq.question: Will the course cover project documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. The work includes requirements, process maps, solution structure, test scenarios, and handover planning.

faq.question: What roles can this support?
faq.answer: The skills align with Odoo Implementor, Functional Consultant, ERP Business Analyst, and implementation-support responsibilities.

instructor.name: Maram
instructor.bio: Analyzes operational challenges and helps translate business requirements into clear ERP learning and implementation concepts.
